486:t_023:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Hang in there, $$鉄人$$! You're the power of hope Dad left me...!」

486:t_023:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「You're the Messenger of the Sun!」

486:t_024:0.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「What!? A mere Earthling brat has broken through my psychic waves!?」

486:t_024:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's do this, $$鉄人$$! We'll hit the $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$ with the hearts of everyone fighting beside you and me, and the power of the sun!」

486:t_025:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「How's that, $$宇宙魔王#pilot$$! Did you see the power of the Solar Energy Converter Dr. $$敷島$$ improved for me!」

486:t_025:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「When did you get something like that!?」

486:t_025:3.en:
$$正太郎$$
「After $$ゲシュタルト$$ made $$鉄人$$ go berserk the other day, I gave the data to Dr. $$敷島$$ and had him modify it as a countermeasure.」

486:t_025:4.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Now, even if $$鉄人$$ releases solar energy and unleashes its super power, it will never go berserk!」

486:t_025:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「Never drowning in that power, and using it for what's right, huh...」

486:t_026:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「You're right, $$ダイターン$$... We can't afford to lose, either.」

486:t_026:2.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「$$ダイターン３$$ is alive...」

486:t_026:4.en:
$$万丈$$
「...$$ダイターン$$ is a prototype $$メガボーグ$$. It doesn't normally show itself, but a will dwells within it.」

486:t_026:5.en:
$$万丈$$
「And now, having received the solar energy $$鉄人$$ released, $$ダイターン$$ has grown with that power!」

486:t_026:6.en:
$$勝平$$
「It can do something like that!?」

486:t_026:7.en:
$$万丈$$
「Of course it can! Originally, even the $$メガノイド$$s must have been built dreaming of the future!」

486:t_026:8.en:
$$万丈$$
「With the radiance of the sun hidden in my heart, my body... $$ダイターン$$ is burning!」

486:t_027:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$勝平$$, $$ワッ太$$! The $$ダイターン$$ of today should be able to pull off a combination with your powered-up robots, too!」

486:t_027:2.en:
$$勝平$$
「Been a while, but let's do this!」

486:t_028:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「What do you intend to do!?」

486:t_028:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$コンピュータードール#pilot$$! There was a time I hated human ego fiercely, just like you!」

486:t_028:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「But at the same time, I learned! That ego is exactly what makes humans human!」

486:t_028:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I refuse...! To be consumed by ego, or to deny all of it!」

486:t_029:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「But if humans advance further... what awaits them is that lot...」

486:t_029:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Whatever is there, we won't stop fighting!」

486:t_029:2.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「No matter what enemies are out there, we'll definitely win!」

486:t_029:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is the power of humanity! The power of life!」

486:t_030:0.en:
$$万丈$$
「Here I come, $$コンピュータードール#pilot$$!」

486:t_031:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「What do you intend to do!?」

486:t_031:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$コンピュータードール#pilot$$! There was a time I hated human ego fiercely, just like you!」

486:t_031:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「But at the same time, I learned! That ego is exactly what makes humans human!」

486:t_031:3.en:
$$万丈$$
「I refuse...! To be consumed by ego, or to deny all of it!」

486:t_032:0.en:
$$ガイゾック$$
「But if humans advance further... what awaits them is that lot...」

486:t_032:1.en:
$$万丈$$
「Whatever is there, we'll keep fighting, and we will win!」

486:t_032:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「That is the power of humanity! The power of life!」

486:t_033:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Awesome! $$ダイターン３$$ has powered up too!」

486:t_033:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「The $$ダイターン$$ of today should be able to pull off a combination with your powered-up robots, too.」

486:t_034:0.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Impossible...! Are these people reaching the sun's radiance on their own power!?」

486:t_034:1.en:
$$不動$$
「Yes. They are worthy of it.」

486:t_034:2.en:
$$不動$$
「That is the shine of the light within them... It is exactly what is called radiance.」

486:t_035:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
「You must accept it, Father. You too, $$皇帝ズール$$.」

486:t_035:2.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「$$グーラ$$! Do you intend to defy me, your own father!?」

486:t_035:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「...Since that day 12,000 years ago, when our planet was swallowed by the black hole, you have changed, Father...」

486:t_035:4.en:
$$グーラ$$
「We too should have advanced toward the radiance of the sun like the people of Earth, but we fell into the abyss of darkness and lost sight of the light.」

486:t_035:5.en:
$$グーラ$$
「The only thing I can do is free you from that, Father!」

486:t_035:6.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「Very well, $$グーラ$$. You are no longer my child.」

486:t_035:7.en:
$$ズール$$
「Earthlings. You have indeed grown strong.」

486:t_035:8.en:
$$ズール$$
「To fight you, suitable preparations are required.」

486:t_035:10.en:
$$ズール$$
「Mind your tongue, $$マーズ$$. The place where I will meet you in battle is not here.」

486:t_035:11.en:
$$宇宙魔王#pilot$$
「I shall be waiting, Earthlings... and you too, $$グーラ$$. For the time when you come to the place of the true battle.」

486:t_037:0.en:
$$ゲシュタルト$$
「I will be your opponent.」

486:t_037:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「So he left $$ゲシュタルト$$ behind!」

486:t_037:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Don't think an avatar can stop us at this point!」

486:t_038:0.en:
$$グーラ$$
「$$正太郎$$... Now, at last, I will fight alongside you.」

486:t_038:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$グーラ$$... The day has finally come, hasn't it.」

486:t_038:2.en:
$$グーラ$$
「My father and $$ズール$$ are waiting for you. There is no need to chase them any longer.」

486:t_038:3.en:
$$グーラ$$
「From now on I will fight with you, and free them from the depths of darkness!」

486:t_039:1.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've been waiting for this moment!」

486:t_039:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「All that's left is to take care of the rest of them and go home to our world!」

486:t_039:4.en:
$$アポロ$$
「That's how it is, $$ミカゲ$$! If you want to get in on this too, I'll take you on!」
